tools.name: find_clinics
tools.description: Find UK clinics that prescribe cannabis-based medicines, nearest first with `near`, filtered by condition, consultation type, CQC rating, fee or patient type. Returns fees, year-one cost and CQC rating; not doctors or appointments. Example: {"near":"Leeds","consultationType":"ONLINE"}

tools.name: get_clinic
tools.description: One clinic in full: address, hours, fees and price list, CQC record, patient types taken, partner pharmacies, FAQs. Example: {"slug":"green-leaf-clinic"}

tools.name: find_pharmacies
tools.description: Find UK pharmacies that dispense a clinic's prescription, nearest first with `near`, filtered by delivery, collection or rating. Never stock or medicine prices. Example: {"near":"M1 1AE","delivers":true}

tools.name: get_pharmacy
tools.description: One pharmacy in full: address, hours, delivery options and prices, GPhC record, partner clinics, FAQs. Never stock or medicine prices. Example: {"slug":"city-pharmacy"}

tools.name: find_products
tools.description: Find cannabis-based medicines on the UK market by name, brand, strain or dose form, with THC/CBD and the latest public price. Never stock, pack sizes on offer or per-pharmacy prices. Example: {"query":"Pink Kush","category":"FLOWER"}

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product in full: form, strength, strain, brand, terpenes, contents, leaflets, FAQs and its price range when published. Never stock. Example: {"slug":"pink-kush-t22"}

tools.name: find_strains
tools.description: Find strain profiles by name or genetics, with THC/CBD ranges. No effects or medical uses are published. Example: {"genetics":"Hybrid"}

tools.name: get_strain
tools.description: One strain in full: genetics, cannabinoid ranges, terpenes, flavours, lineage, products made from it, FAQs. Example: {"slug":"gelato"}

tools.name: find_brands
tools.description: Find the brands that make cannabis-based medicines, by name or dose form, with their listed product counts. Example: {"query":"Tilray"}

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: One brand in full: location, website, its listed products and FAQs. Example: {"slug":"tilray"}

tools.name: find_articles
tools.description: Find Findabis articles (UK law, prescriptions, clinics, products) by words or category, newest first. Example: {"query":"travel abroad"}

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read one Findabis article as plain text, with byline, dates and page link. Members-only articles return the link only. Example: {"slug":"how-to-get-a-prescription"}

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Compare 2-6 clinics (fees, year-one cost, CQC, ratings) or 2-6 pharmacies (delivery, GPhC, ratings) side by side. Services only, never medicines. Example: {"kind":"clinic","slugs":["clinic-a","clinic-b"]}

tools.name: search_directory
tools.description: Search clinics, pharmacies, products, strains, brands and articles at once, when the kind is unknown or to get a slug. Each match has a kind, slug, URL and one-line summary. Example: {"query":"Glasgow"}

tools.name: get_directory_facts
tools.description: Live directory totals: listings by kind, the first-consultation fee range and median, and how many pharmacies deliver, with dates. Takes no input. Example: {}
